msg: ADR 0026 P1c addendum. Current head c0aa238 green here (13, 182/183, 101; ADR 0026 x2, P1b x3, no strays); landing deferred to P1c as you planned. (1) A rename-based reclaim does NOT close the TOCTOU: waiter B, having seen the DEAD pid, can still mv away A's FRESH lock. Close it with a reclaim mutex: only the holder of a second mkdir lock (tics-emit.lock.reclaim) may break the main lock, and it must RE-READ the pid/age under that mutex before removing; the reclaim mutex itself is age-bounded. (2) Pin the loss path the double-hold enables: 'rebase --abort' hard-resets to orig-head, so if another process committed in between, its tic FILE is removed from the worktree — a real drop. P1c should include: with a forced double-hold, no tic file is ever deleted (assert every emitted msg reaches origin after a sync).
